LanguageData.ASE_Heavy_Plating_T1.label: heavy plating T1
LanguageData.ASE_Heavy_Plating_T1.description: The android is covered with additional armor plates. Stronger - but noticeably slower.
LanguageData.ASE_Heavy_Plating_T2.label: heavy plating T2
LanguageData.ASE_Heavy_Plating_T2.description: Thick armor plates turn the android into a walking tank, sacrificing most of its mobility.
LanguageData.ASE_Heavy_Plating_T3.label: heavy plating T3
LanguageData.ASE_Heavy_Plating_T3.description: Armor protection has been brought to incredible levels. Almost invulnerable, but barely able to move or work.
LanguageData.ASE_ReactiveArmor.label: reactive armor
LanguageData.ASE_ReactiveArmor.description: Reactive armor that damages attackers in melee combat (reflects 100% of melee damage back to attackers, but the android also takes damage). Warning: in case of critical damage, the android may explode!
LanguageData.ASE_ReactiveArmor.customEffectDescriptio: Melee attacks on the android damage both the attacker and the android
LanguageData.ASE_DeflectorSystem.label: deflector system
LanguageData.ASE_DeflectorSystem.description: Experimental reflective panels that reflect bullets back at attackers. Trigger approximately 50% of the time.
LanguageData.ASE_DeflectorSystem.customEffectDescript: 50% chance to reflect shots back at attacker
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T1.label: anti-insectoid plates
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T1.description: Damn insectoids got everyone! Additional layers of experimental composite armor will help better withstand clashes with these creatures.
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T1.customEffectD: Additional armor with 80 durability that works against melee damage
Can be restored (depends on crafting skill)
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T2.label: double anti-insectoid plates
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T2.description: Damn insectoids really got everyone! Additional layers of experimental composite armor will help better withstand clashes with these creatures.
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T2.customEffectD: Additional armor with 160 durability that works against melee damage
Can be restored (depends on crafting skill)
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T3.label: quadro anti-insectoid plates
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T3.description: Damn insectoids got everyone so badly that engineers took extreme measures! Additional layers of experimental composite armor will help withstand a clash with an entire army of these creatures!
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_T3.customEffectD: Additional armor with 300 durability that works against melee damage
Can be restored (depends on crafting skill)
LanguageData.ASE_AutoRepairModule.label: auto-repair module
LanguageData.ASE_AutoRepairModule.description: One of the most expensive and coveted technologies in the rim worlds, regenerative nano-machines restore any damage (even in combat), but consume a fabulous amount of energy
LanguageData.ASE_AutoRepairModule.customEffectDescrip: Lost limbs require more time to restore
LanguageData.ASE_SilverOverlay.label: silver overlay
LanguageData.ASE_SilverOverlay.description: A special silver coating has been applied to the android's armor. Makes the android noticeably stronger.
LanguageData.ASE_SilverOverlay.customEffectDescriptio: +40 to all three types of armor (sharp, blunt, heat)
LanguageData.ASE_GoldenOverlay.label: golden overlay
LanguageData.ASE_GoldenOverlay.description: A special gold coating has been applied to the android's armor. Makes the android even stronger, but greatly increases its cost and attracts unwanted attention.
LanguageData.ASE_DiamondOverlay.label: diamond overlay
LanguageData.ASE_DiamondOverlay.description: A special diamond particle coating has been applied to the android's armor. It makes the android much stronger, but due to the cost of materials, half the galaxy will hunt for such androids.
LanguageData.ASE_DiamondOverlay.customEffectDescripti: Daily increases the total colony value
LanguageData.ASE_WallProtocol.label: wall protocol
LanguageData.ASE_WallProtocol.description: The android is designed specifically for protecting settlements in aggressive worlds. Useless for attacking, but it will hold the line forever in defense. Due to huge size and low mobility, unable to travel in caravans.
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischarge.label: toxic discharge
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischarge.description: When taking damage, the android releases a toxic cloud that damages everyone nearby. The system has 5 charges that restore over time.
LanguageData.ASE_Resilience.label: resilience
LanguageData.ASE_Resilience.description: Each blow against the android permanently increases its armor by 0.1%.
Each blow against the android permanently increases its armor by 0.1%
